title: Teaching himself and first gigs with Alfred Williams
summary: Self-taught, he played in his late teens with Alfred Williams and pianist Steve Lewis at a Howard Street hall.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: So you went out and you bought this trumpet in the pawn shop and how did you start? Did you take lessons or did you just figure it out yourself?

I just figured it out myself. And I was blowing around and I played with, during that time before I learned how to read, was playing with guys like Alfred Williams. And so Alfred Williams and I played with Steve Lewis, piano player. We played at the place, at the Saint-Sou Hall on Howard Street between Washington and 6. I played there with him and I was just, oh, I was about, oh, my teens, late teens at that time.
